background_story: Titan was a Portland institution, a food truck that had been serving up the city's best Vietnamese fusion cuisine for over a decade. Born out of a passion for bold flavors and sustainable ingredients, Titan quickly gained a loyal following among the city's foodies. From its iconic 'PDX Pork' banh mi to its innovative 'Voodoo Veggie' bowls, every dish on the menu was a love letter to Portland's eclectic vibe. Titan's owner, Linh, was a Portland native who had grown up exploring the city's many neighborhoods and culinary scenes. She poured her heart and soul into the truck, which became a staple at festivals, breweries, and street food gatherings throughout the city. Titan's success was a testament to Portland's spirit of creativity and community, and its food remained a beloved part of the city's fabric.
